mapper.update: WITH recent AS (SELECT id FROM work WHERE state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND year >= #{fromYear}), total AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM recent), fresh AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT wn.name_string_id, count(DISTINCT wn.work_id)::int AS works, (count(DISTINCT wn.work_id)::double precision / total.n)::real AS share FROM work_name wn JOIN recent r ON r.id = wn.work_id, total WHERE NOT wn.only_reference GROUP BY wn.name_string_id, total.n), del AS (DELETE FROM name_ubiquity u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.name_string_id = u.name_string_id) AND coalesce(u.scored_share, 0) = 0), zero AS (UPDATE name_ubiquity u SET works = 0, share = 0, computed_at = now() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.name_string_id = u.name_string_id) AND coalesce(u.scored_share, 0) > 0) INSERT INTO name_ubiquity (name_string_id, works, share, computed_at) SELECT name_string_id, works, share, now() FROM fresh ON CONFLICT (name_string_id) DO UPDATE SET works = excluded.works, share = excluded.share, computed_at = excluded.computed_at

WITH fresh AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT t.taxon_id, w.year, count(DISTINCT wn.work_id)::int AS works, (count(DISTINCT wn.work_id) FILTER (WHERE wn.main_subject))::int AS main_subject_works FROM work_name wn JOIN work w ON w.id = wn.work_id AND w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year IS NOT NULL CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(wn.taxon_path) AS t(taxon_id) WHERE NOT wn.only_reference GROUP BY t.taxon_id, w.year), del AS (DELETE FROM taxon_stats s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.taxon_id = s.taxon_id AND f.year = s.year)) INSERT INTO taxon_stats (taxon_id, year, works, main_subject_works) SELECT taxon_id, year, works, main_subject_works FROM fresh ON CONFLICT (taxon_id, year) DO UPDATE SET works = excluded.works, main_subject_works = excluded.main_subject_works

WITH fresh AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT t.taxon_id, coalesce(w.language, '') AS language, w.year, count(DISTINCT wn.work_id)::int AS works FROM work_name wn JOIN work w ON w.id = wn.work_id AND w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year IS NOT NULL CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(wn.taxon_path) AS t(taxon_id) WHERE NOT wn.only_reference GROUP BY t.taxon_id, coalesce(w.language, ''), w.year), del AS (DELETE FROM taxon_language_stats s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.taxon_id = s.taxon_id AND f.language = s.language AND f.year = s.year)) INSERT INTO taxon_language_stats (taxon_id, language, year, works) SELECT taxon_id, language, year, works FROM fresh ON CONFLICT (taxon_id, language, year) DO UPDATE SET works = excluded.works

WITH fresh AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT d.dim, d.value, coalesce(w.language, '') AS language, w.year, count(*)::bigint AS works FROM work w LEFT JOIN source s ON s.id = w.source_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT 'none' AS dim, '' AS value UNION ALL SELECT 'taxgroup', g FROM unnest(w.taxgroups) AS g UNION ALL SELECT 'code', c FROM unnest(w.codes) AS c UNION ALL SELECT 'country', s.country WHERE coalesce(s.country, '') <> '') AS d WHERE w.state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND w.year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.dim, d.value, coalesce(w.language, ''), w.year), del AS (DELETE FROM language_stats s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fresh f WHERE f.dim = s.dim AND f.value = s.value AND f.language = s.language AND f.year = s.year)) INSERT INTO language_stats (dim, value, language, year, works) SELECT dim, value, language, year, works FROM fresh ON CONFLICT (dim, value, language, year) DO UPDATE SET works = excluded.works
mapper.select: SELECT language, year, works FROM taxon_language_stats WHERE taxon_id = #{taxonId} ORDER BY year, works DESC, language

SELECT coalesce(language, '') AS language, year, count(*) AS works FROM work WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND state IN ('INDEXED','NOTIFIED') AND year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY coalesce(language, ''), year ORDER BY year, works DESC, language
